certificate.reason: Pure measurement/diagnostic run. No discrete log is claimed, no factor-base relation is claimed, no isogeny problem instance is solved. PART A is a code regression test of a shared arithmetic helper; PART B is a graph-structural diagnostic over already-committed delta_E data. docs/claims-and-verification.md requires kind: none to be stated explicitly for such runs.

objective_boundary: PART A is a shared-library regression fix, unrelated to H-SSIQ-36e970's own prediction. Scale: toy, graph sizes 203-611 vertices; no result transfers to cryptographic scale.
